properties.name: v0.21.0 re-scoped: it ships the evidence-quality family and BL-141(a), not the four agent-facing capabilities it was planned for. Those four (cap:gap-carries-a-reading, cap:session-artifacts, cap:skill-triggers, cap:tool-carries-convention) are all `expected` rather than `required`, so nothing blocks the cut under dec:release-trigger — and their SCHEDULED_FOR edges are DELIBERATELY LEFT POINTED AT THIS RELEASE rather than moved. That makes arrival_delta report them as `outstanding`: still pointed at an arrived moment, not delivered, nobody having said whether they slip or drop. Re-pointing them would assert a decision Anthony has not made, and dropping them would assert a withdrawal he has not made — the exact failure the fifth outcome was added to prevent.
